name: Khang Nguyen Tran
headline: I take advanced-node blocks from netlist to GDSII — floorplan, CTS, timing closure and signoff — and leave behind a flow the next engineer can run without me.
summary: Physical Design Engineer with 3.5 years of hands-on netlist-to-GDSII ownership on taped-out blocks in 7nm, 16nm and 14nm-class designs. I have closed timing, congestion and physical verification on blocks from 13K to 3.7M instances, up to ~801 MHz, and I work the way senior PD engineers are expected to: diagnose before optimizing, script the repetitive work, and take a block to signoff rather than to "mostly done".

availability.note: Eligible to work up to 24 hours per week during the Winter 2027 term, and full-time (40 hours per week) for Summer 2027 co-op terms.
